lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Tell me about that. What did he say about her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That she looked good and she was pretty nice.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. Did he tell ya where she worked?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell ya how he was gonna get her in the house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did he, do you know?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So a couple days prior you said there this lady he knows or tell me how he says that. I don't wanna put words in your mouth, tell me how he says it to you.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he had a girl coming over ta take a picture of a van.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. What else?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: And then that he would do that ta her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: No, wha-tell me exactly what he said.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he would kill her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he laugh about it or what? Why did, why did he say he was gonna kill her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he was pissed off that Jodi was in jail again.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Why is he pissed off that Jodi was in jail? Did he tell ya why?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Oh, yes he did. He told you why he was pissed off. Probably cuz he wasn't gettin' any or something like that's my guess. You know what I mean by that?
